quote: He who reads much and travels much sees and knows a great deal.
source: Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quixote, Part II, chapter 25 (Don Quixote) (trans. John Ormsby, 1885)
speaker: Don Quixote

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg etext 996 (Ormsby) downloaded and searched directly. The text reads: “Now I declare,” said Don Quixote, “he who reads much and travels much sees and knows a great deal. I say so because what amount of persuasion could have persuaded me that there are apes in the world that can divine as I have seen now with my own eyes?”
evidence.edition: The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha, trans. John Ormsby, Smith, Elder and Co., London, 1885 (Project Gutenberg etext 996)
evidence.locator: Part II, chapter XXV, the braying adventure and the puppet showman with the divining ape
